channel.title: Lantern Works: GPU price-moves digest
channel.description: Digest of the biggest tracked GPU rental price moves (daily and 7-day), per GPU-hour in USD. Each move links the vendor's own pricing page. 'Biggest' and 'cheapest' are among tracked providers only.
